rows.label: PHASE
rows.clue: Any distinct time period in a sequence of events

rows.label: CONVEYING
rows.clue: Act of transferring property title from one person to another

rows.label: SEA SQUIRT
rows.clue: Ascidian that can contract its body and eject streams of water

rows.label: USURY
rows.clue: An exorbitant or unlawful rate of interest

rows.label: TITLE DEED
rows.clue: A legal document proving a person's right to property

rows.label: CLUCK
rows.clue: The sound made by a hen (as in calling her chicks)

rows.label: POUCH
rows.clue: A small or medium size container for holding or carrying things

rows.label: HARD CANDY
rows.clue: Candy that is brittle

rows.label: POOR
rows.clue: People without possessions or wealth (considered as a group)

rows.label: ABSCISSA
rows.clue: The value of a coordinate on the horizontal axis

rows.label: FUMES
rows.clue: Gases ejected from an engine as waste products

rows.label: AMPERAGE
rows.clue: The strength of an electrical current measured in amperes

rows.label: MOON
rows.clue: The natural satellite of the Earth

rows.label: ACRE
rows.clue: A unit of area (4840 square yards) used in English-speaking countries

rows.label: ABUTMENT
rows.clue: Point of contact between two objects or parts

rows.label: MULBERRY

rows.label: SPASMODIC
rows.clue: Affected by involuntary jerky muscular contractions

rows.label: SECOND
rows.clue: 1/60 of a minute

rows.label: ACTION
rows.clue: Something done (usually as opposed to something said)

rows.label: TALON
rows.clue: A sharp hooked claw especially on a bird of prey

rows.label: HEDGING
rows.clue: Any technique designed to reduce or eliminate financial risk

rows.label: PRAGMATIC
rows.clue: An imperial decree that becomes part of the fundamental law of the land

rows.label: RECEDING
rows.clue: A slow or gradual disappearance

rows.label: HOME BASE
rows.clue: (baseball) base consisting of a rubber slab where the batter stands

rows.label: MINT CANDY
rows.clue: A candy that is flavored with a mint oil

rows.label: HARD CORE
rows.clue: The most dedicated and intensely loyal nucleus of a group or movement

rows.label: CASUISTRY
rows.clue: Argumentation that is specious or excessively subtle and intended to be misleading

rows.label: CAST IRON
rows.clue: An alloy of iron containing so much carbon that it is brittle and so cannot be wrought but must be shaped by casting

rows.label: SPRINKLE
rows.clue: A light shower that falls in some locations and not others nearby

rows.label: AERY
rows.clue: The lofty nest of a bird of prey (such as a hawk or eagle)

rows.label: AREA UNIT
rows.clue: A system of units used to measure areas

rows.label: SKID ROAD
rows.clue: The district of a town frequented by loggers

rows.label: FAN PALM
rows.clue: Palm having palmate or fan-shaped leaves

rows.label: FINITE
rows.clue: Bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent

rows.label: MINUTE
rows.clue: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

rows.label: BULLDOZE
rows.clue: Flatten with or as if with a bulldozer

rows.label: BRONCO
rows.clue: An unbroken or imperfectly broken mustang

rows.label: PASSBOOK
rows.clue: A record of deposits and withdrawals and interest held by depositors at certain banks

rows.label: BABY TALK
rows.clue: An adult's imitation of the speech of a young child

rows.label: CAMPAIGN
rows.clue: A race between candidates for elective office

rows.label: WOODWIND
rows.clue: Any wind instrument other than the brass instruments

rows.label: TREACLE
rows.clue: A pale cane syrup

rows.label: SYMPOSIUM
rows.clue: A meeting or conference for the public discussion of some topic especially one in which the participants form an audience and make presentations

rows.label: TOPOLOGY
rows.clue: Topographic study of a given place (especially the history of the place as indicated by its topography)

rows.label: BRAN
rows.clue: Broken husks of the seeds of cereal grains that are separated from the flour by sifting

rows.label: SANDBLAST
rows.clue: A blast of wind laden with sand

rows.label: BINARY
rows.clue: A system of two stars that revolve around each other under their mutual gravitation

rows.label: GILL
rows.clue: A British imperial capacity unit (liquid or dry) equal to 5 fluid ounces or 142.066 cubic centimeters

rows.label: SIDE
rows.clue: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location

rows.label: HEAD SMUT
rows.clue: Smut fungus attacking heads of corn or sorghum and causing a covered smut

rows.label: ILLEGAL
rows.clue: Prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules

rows.label: EXPIRY
rows.clue: A coming to an end of a contract period

rows.label: BED REST
rows.clue: Confinement to bed continuously (as in the case of some sick or injured persons)

rows.label: CIVET
rows.clue: Cat-like mammal typically secreting musk used in perfumes

rows.label: SALVAGE
rows.clue: Property or goods saved from damage or destruction

rows.label: EXPRESS
rows.clue: Mail that is distributed by a rapid and efficient system

rows.label: WHISTLE
rows.clue: The sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture

rows.label: HAIR SLIDE
rows.clue: A decorative hinged clip that girls and women put in their hair to hold it in place

rows.label: SOFT DRINK
rows.clue: Nonalcoholic beverage (usually carbonated)

rows.label: MAIMED
rows.clue: People who are wounded

rows.label: OVERLAP
rows.clue: A representation of common ground between theories or phenomena

rows.label: TALC
rows.clue: A fine grained mineral having a soft soapy feel and consisting of hydrated magnesium silicate

rows.label: MIST
rows.clue: A thin fog with condensation near the ground

rows.clue: A pass in a mountain ridge through which a stream flows
